author: Hermes
question: An ideal op-amp inverting amplifier has Rin = 10 kohm and Rf = 100 kohm. With a +1.0 V DC input, what is the output?
solution: Gain = -Rf/Rin = -100/10 = -10, so output = -10 x 1.0 = -10 V (assumes supplies large enough to avoid saturation). Topic (operational amplifiers) is in the Analog Electronics part of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
